panels.title: Infrastructure Status
panels.description: 0 = DOWN (red), 1 = RECOVERING (yellow, was down in the last 10 min), 2 = UP (green). UDM = udm_thermal.up; the rest = service_health.up.

targets.query:
udmUp = from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "udm_thermal" and r._field == "up")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with service: "udm" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "service"])

svcUp = from(bucket: "kube_metrics")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_health" and r._field == "up")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "service"])

allUp = union(tables: [udmUp, svcUp]) |> group(columns: ["service"])
current = allUp |> last() |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "current"})
recent  = allUp |> min()  |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "recent"})

join(tables: {c: current, r: recent}, on: ["service"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      service: r.service,
      _value: if r.current == 0.0 then 0.0 else if r.recent == 0.0 then 1.0 else 2.0,
  }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with service:
        if r.service == "influxdb" then "𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐥𝐮𝐱𝐃𝐁"
        else if r.service == "bifrost" then "𝐁𝐢𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐭"
        else if r.service == "openwebui" then "𝐎𝐩𝐞𝐧 𝐖𝐞𝐛 𝐔𝐈"
        else if r.service == "ollama" then "𝐎𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐚"
        else if r.service == "udm" then "𝐔𝐃𝐌"
        else r.service }))
  |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "state")

panels.title: Availability (1 = up, 0 = down)
panels.description: Per-service up/down over time (min per window, so any outage shows as a dip to 0).

targets.query:
udmUp = from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "udm_thermal" and r._field == "up")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with service: "udm" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "service"])

svcUp = from(bucket: "kube_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_health" and r._field == "up")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "service"])

union(tables: [udmUp, svcUp])
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "availability")

panels.title: Response Time (ms)
panels.description: Two series per service: '(server)' = server_ms, the service's own processing time (connection/TLS excluded) — the fair cross-service comparison; '(total)' = latency_ms, total client-observed time including DNS + TCP + TLS + ingress (HTTPS services carry ~200ms of TLS handshake, so total is much higher).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "kube_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_health" and r._field == "server_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.0)
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "server_ms"})
  |> yield(name: "server")

from(bucket: "kube_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_health" and r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.0)
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "client_ms"})
  |> yield(name: "client")

panels.title: Synthetic Monitor — samples (last 3m)
panels.description: Health of the monitor itself: service_health points written in the last 3 minutes (expect ~24 = 4 services x ~6). If this drops to 0 the probe is silent and availability is UNKNOWN — the 'Infrastructure monitor is silent' alert fires.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "kube_metrics")
  |> range(start: -3m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_health" and r._field == "up")
  |> group()
  |> count()
